Potential_all18_complete_headers.name: Resources.budget_append
Potential_all18_complete_headers.source_header:
theorem budget_append [Zero C] [Add C] [AddMonoid D]
    (step : ι → σ → σ × C) (charge : ι → σ → D)
    (is js : List ι) (s : σ) :
    budget step charge (is ++ js) s =
      budget step charge is s + budget step charge js (run step is s).1

theorem budget_map [AddZero D] [AddZero E] (h : D →+ E)
    (step : ι → σ → σ × C) (charge : ι → σ → D) (is : List ι) (s : σ) :
    h (budget step charge is s) = budget step (fun i s => h (charge i s)) is s

    (step : ι → σ → σ × C) (potential : σ → D) (h : C →+ D)
    (is : List ι) (s : σ) :
    budget step (fun i s => h (step i s).2 + potential (step i s).1 - potential s) is s =
      h (run step is s).2 + potential (run step is s).1 - potential s
